name: The traveling dove
title: A blessing, Ephesians 3:20-21
note: Dove posted, three videos, one needed a second status check
caption:
A blessing for your week. Follow the dove to the end.
God can do far more than anything we would think to ask for, and His power is already at work in us. That is a good hope to hold over someone you love this Sunday.
Ephesians 3:20-21 (BSB)
